changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_feed_for_player( p_player_id uuid, p_limit int DEFAULT 20, p_offset int DEFAULT 0, p_types text[] DEFAULT NULL, p_since timestamptz DEFAULT NULL ) RETURNS TABLE ( id uuid, actor_player_id uuid, actor_club_id uuid, activity_type varchar(50), reference_type varchar(50), reference_id uuid, visibility varchar(20), metadata jsonb, created_at timestamptz, geo_score int ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ WITH scored AS ( SELECT a.id, a.actor_player_id, a.actor_club_id, a.activity_type, a.reference_type, a.reference_id, a.visibility, a.metadata, a.created_at, -- The actor is either a player or a club; take whichever -- location exists. Comparison is case-insensitive and -- trimmed because both columns are free text (see the -- note in 003-club) and "Cebu City" vs "cebu city" is -- the same place to a human. COALESCE( CASE WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.barangay, c.barangay))) = lower(btrim(v.barangay)) AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.city, c.city))) = lower(btrim(v.city)) THEN 3 WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.city, c.city))) = lower(btrim(v.city)) AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.province, c.province))) = lower(btrim(v.province)) THEN 2 WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.province, c.province))) = lower(btrim(v.province)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0 ) AS geo_score, -- The old reprioritize() rule, folded in as a tiebreak -- so there is one ordering rather than two. CASE WHEN c.verification_status = 'verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS verified_score FROM activities a LEFT JOIN player_profiles pp ON pp.id = a.actor_player_id LEFT JOIN clubs c ON c.id = a.actor_club_id -- The viewer's own location. A plain LEFT JOIN, so a NULL -- p_player_id (signed out) or a player with no location -- set yields NULLs, every CASE branch below falls through -- to 0, and the feed degrades to plain newest-first. LEFT JOIN player_profiles v ON v.id = p_player_id WHERE a.visibility = 'public' AND (p_types IS NULL OR a.activity_type = ANY(p_types)) AND (p_since IS NULL OR a.created_at > p_since) ) SELECT id, actor_player_id, actor_club_id, activity_type, reference_type, reference_id, visibility, metadata, created_at, geo_score FROM scored ORDER BY geo_score DESC, verified_score DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset; $$;
changeSet.rollback: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS fn_feed_for_player(uuid, int, int, text[], timestamptz);
